physicalNotes: Radius 0.11820879 Jupiter radii from Bonfanti et al. 2024 (2024A&A...682A..66B), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...682A..66B/abstract): 8,451 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius.
